title: Pepper and cottage cheese frittata
summary: A thick omelette of roasted peppers and cottage cheese. It sets on a low flame under a lid, so the middle stays tender.

steps.instruction: Slice the pepper and spring onion. Beat the eggs with the parsley, paprika, pepper and half the salt.
Warm the oil and soften the pepper and spring onion until the pepper is sweet.
Stir the cottage cheese into the eggs with the rest of the salt.
Pour the eggs over the peppers and cook on a low heat, covered, until the centre is just set. Warm the pittas beside the pan for the last minute.
steps.tip: A lid finishes the top without a grill. Keep the flame low so the base does not brown too fast.
